claim_scope.statement: the estimand is the equal-weight mean over the six frozen prompt forms; it is not a population-level prompt claim and not calibration

complete_pair_rule: real and placebo both valid and identity-matched; incomplete pairs reported, not dropped; a form with no complete pair contributes no effect

estimand.form_effect: within-form mean of the event difference
estimand.null_branch: cancels from the primary contrast; retained for real-minus-null and placebo-minus-null manipulation checks

form_capacity_audit.note: seed disjointness does not create new prompt forms: the generator yields six paired ISO/FULL forms across every seed block audited
form_capacity_audit.recommendation: conditional on the six known frozen forms; a generator redesign is required for genuinely new forms

feasible_set_mass.reference_set: F = pre-read clue-consistent set S(C), fixed by C and independent of the real message

guards.objective_information: I_m kept distinct from model entropy

inference.primary: form-mean t interval (df=k-1) and exhaustive two-sided cluster sign-flip p

manifest.note: seed-disjoint IDs do not create new forms; the study is conditional on the six forms regardless of the block chosen

missingness: planned/attempted/valid/complete/incomplete reported per form and per branch
pending_decisions: confirm the conditional six-form claim scope (vs generator redesign)
set the target-probability margin delta and feasible-set-mass slack epsilon
set the minimum complete pairs per form
fix the placebo construction rule (I_m = 0, no feasible-set reduction)
choose one-sided directional vs two-sided decision rule

power.label: illustrative and secondary
power.sd_caveat: the observed J3 between-form SD is from ISO-minus-FULL, not the real-minus-placebo estimand; use only as an illustrative sensitivity value, not a plug-in variance
